checks: Toolbar opens the real import dialog; preview uses issue and online dates without writing
One write adds both records to the chosen collection with complete identifiers
PMID aliases and explicitly chosen title candidates cannot duplicate an existing DOI
Right-click batch updates existing keys and keeps PDFs, collection, short title and Extra
A standalone PDF is attached to a new parent without replacing the file
Explicit preprint relation previews a linked version and avoids an existing published DOI
Stale preview rejects an update while a new preview can save
Batch updates expand MEDLINE pages and omit unchanged entries on repeat lookup
Collective author is saved first as a single field and survives partial source responses
Proceedings title and volume survive Crossref fallback and conflicting publisher is preserved
Offline journal abbreviations update multiple articles by ISSN and title in one batch
Crossref batch retry preserves the formal date and publisher through writeback
Batch date conflicts preserve dates while verified fields are written
File import opens Zotero's wizard and imports RIS into the selected collection

testMethod: Metadata suite only. Tests simulate 429 and temporary HTTP service errors across six sources. An isolated Zotero 10 profile verifies that conflicting dates stay unchanged while creators, publication title, abbreviation, publisher, volume, issue, pages, ISSN, PMID, PMCID and URL are written in a batch. Fixtures also cover version and DOI handling, notes and attachment preservation, and single-source data fallback.
